title: 8-LED chase with speed, direction and reset
summary: A single lit LED moves along LED0-LED7 towards higher LEDs at 2 steps per second, wrapping around. BTNU held: 6 steps per second. SW0 up reverses the direction. BTNC restarts the chase from LED0.
assumptions: The chase starts on LED0 after configuration
'left' means towards higher LED numbers; SW0 up (direction 'down') moves towards LED0
